# Manual Sync Instructions

Before returning from any task, perform a documentation impact check.

## If you changed any of these:

- command-line usage
- generated run files
- source/library path behavior
- sandbox/run directory creation
- workspace boundary instructions
- continuation prompts
- HELLO.md handling
- read-only library behavior
- manual run workflow

## Then check these manuals:

- `docs/manuals/user-manual.en.md`
- `docs/manuals/jie-personal-manual.zh.md`

## Required return report

Include:

- Did this change affect operational flow? yes/no
- If yes, which manual sections were updated?
- If not updated, why not?
- Were any user-local files avoided, especially `src/config.py`?
